title: pgsql: Handle protocol version bump in startup message
description:
Between PG7.4 and PG17, the protocol version used was 3.0 (or 196608).
Starting PG18, this protocol version was bumped to 3.2 (196610), as
decribed in https://www.postgresql.org/docs/18/protocol-message-formats.html#PROTOCOL-MESSAGE-FORMATS-STARTUPMESSAGE

To handle future protocol version bump, this patch modifies the startup
message to check that the protocol version is between 3.0 and 3.9999.

3.9999 is used as the maximum to match the current grease version used
in PG19 beta (https://www.postgresql.org/message-id/flat/CAOYmi%2Bkqt_gn-wvUjJG1j3MM4LDDsRMURSPz2eMxfABu0iGtpw%40mail.gmail.com)
